motion.name: tab-state
motion.purpose: Hover and activation of the complete workspace tab; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Shared controls; no press translation or navigation entrance effect.

tab.purpose: Larger labels within compact titlebar tabs, responding to the user's text-to-surface proportion feedback.

body.purpose: Ordinary interface text, controls and tab labels.

supporting.purpose: Metadata and secondary explanations, not ordinary values by default.

narrative.overview: A quiet desktop workspace. The user-selected SiYuan dark direction supplies the neutral palette and compact controls; the supplied Savor screenshot guides integrated titlebar tabs.
keyCharacteristics: One titlebar layer for tools and document tabs
Readable text with compact control padding
Media remains the subject of the workspace

rules.name: One tab surface
rules.body: Type icon, title and close target share the active fill. Close-target space stays reserved when its icon is hidden. New page follows the list.

rules.name: Preserve content while navigating
rules.body: Tab appearance changes preserve retained geometry, focus, history and close preparation. Hide inactive page contents atomically; never animate inherited visibility. Keep the navigation footprint stable while another page mounts.

rules.name: Compact padding, readable labels
rules.body: Ordinary labels retain the body size; supporting-text size is not a way to shrink a large control.

dos: Keep keyboard focus and unresolved-edit indicators visible.
Use primary color for state and important actions.
donts: Do not apply separate button fills to a tab title and its close target.
Do not promote historical green trial colors or unresolved per-page type sizes into new rules.
